utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m trying to keep it simple and low-stress. If we can line up a practical time and a short list of needs, that should keep the repair drive manageable.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — send me the short list and any preferred times, and I’ll keep the locations organized so it stays low-stress.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—let’s pick a clear time for the repair drive and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard folks are still gathering donations and sorting the repair priorities, so a clear time would help me pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check what supplies we’ve got left and make a quick list. Tell me what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — a quick supplies list would be a big help. If you can, note what’s running low first, and I’ll match it to the repair priorities.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great—Gus has the tools covered, so I’ll pass that along to Opal. Just send me the locations when you’re ready, and I’ll help keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — I’ve heard folks are still gathering donations and sorting the biggest fixes first, so I’ll send the locations along when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — that sounds good. One small, flexible task would work for me this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll keep it simple and send you one small task this weekend. Thanks, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks—I'll lock in the time and send the details around so everyone can join easily.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive—what time were you thinking this weekend so I can work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check the supplies and make a quick needs list first; if that works, I’ll pencil in a time around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — are you still able to help this weekend, and what can you bring or take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I’m still in for Sunday at the community center, and I can bring the sign-in sheet plus help set up. If you can spread the location update, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m here now—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think we still just need to lock in the time and keep it steady. Quinn was coordinating, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s still on—let’s pick a clear time and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to jump in—what’s the first thing you want me to handle for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great—could you help me make a quick list of the tools and supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to take the easiest bit off your plate—just point me to the simplest task for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — the simplest thing would be helping sort the tools or setting up the tables.
